sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission examined police Taser use in Western Australia between 2007 and 2009.

sentences.text: It used police force reports, its misconduct assessment work and detailed analyses of reports from selected periods.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that most uses were reasonable, while identifying disproportionate use against Indigenous people and increasing use in potentially excessive or improper circumstances.

cites.document: The use of Taser weapons by the Western Australia Police – summary report

sentences.text: It also found that more frequent Taser use had not reduced the frequency or seriousness of police injuries.

cites.document: The use of Taser weapons by the Western Australia Police – summary report

sentences.text: Its ten recommendations cover risk warnings, a higher threshold for use, restrictions, medical care, repeated deployments, training and a monitoring committee.
